source.source_text: Purpose: return safe metadata for one canonical path without opening protected secret contents. Input: path:string, follow_symlink?:boolean. Output: type,size,timestamps,mode,symlink metadata subject to policy. Contract: L1 read_only; scope mac.files.read; target path; timeout 5000ms; cap 128KiB; network none; filesystem metadata_allowed_roots; secret zones existence-only; approval trusted_read; idempotent yes. Phase 2 planned.
